items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...ask if there's any of the other old-time drummers, anything you could add about, say, old man Cantrell... INTERVIEWEE: Well, you see, all of them I know is like I told you...

ctx.x: Help it a whole lot, help a snare drum out, yeah.
Well, there's about another minute here, I was going to ask if there's any of the other old-time drummers, anything you could add about, say, old man Cantrell, or anybody else?

Well, you see, all of them I know is like I told you, a fellow of you know, he always talk about Black Benny, I never know Benny's right name, but you know Happy. You know Happy, you know, Ernest Rapania, we call it Trap, Faisal, Willigan, I forgot to mention him, that's all, and Alfred William, you know all of them. Yes. Chani, I forgot who that's about him.
